classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 0.09% of the pixels differ by more than 8 levels of a channel and every box has the same bounding box. What is left is the antialiasing along the edge of a circular clip. It covers url(#id) of mask (user-space and box units, luminance and alpha, mask-mode reading a mask as it says, a rule giving the shapes their fill, a missing one hiding the box, one of several layers), of clip-path (units, clip-rule, a missing one clipping nothing), of filter and backdrop-filter (primitives, default and user-space regions, primitives in units of the box, in a list after a native function, a missing one filtering nothing), and the same three named by a data: URL of an SVG. With the references ignored the same fixture measures 23.41%, so it fails.
